name: New Jersey New Home Builder Registration

agency.name: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs Bureau of Homeowner Protection

updateFrequency: registration lookup is current when checked; published builder-list dates vary
knownExclusions: Home improvement, commercial-only construction, trade licenses, permits, inspections, and warranty enrollment are separate.
Registration exceptions and project-specific warranty rules require official interpretation.
rateLimitNotes: Use the public Builder Search manually; account-only registration functions are not a public verification interface.
publicRecordsNotes: DCA publishes a dated builder list and a public search; publication and personal-data handling require review.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: DCA publishes a dated PDF list of registered builders; a stable machine-readable export has not been confirmed.
researchNotes: New-home builder registration is distinct from home-improvement business registration.
maintainerNotes: Future ingestion must preserve registration status and distinguish builder registration from warranty records.

researchEvidence.note: Official DCA guidance states builders must register before constructing new homes and describes covered builder entities.
Official service portal exposes a public active-builder search.
DCA publishes a dated list of New Jersey homebuilders.

blocker.summary: The public search and dated PDF need a stable, privacy-reviewed machine-readable contract before production ingestion.
